decisions.reason: The Magento 2 template builds on the firm's shop hosting know-how, but it has not been visible since 2018 and templates of this kind tend to become outdated, so withdrawal is quite likely even though keeping it costs little.
The responsive template sits close to the firm's CMS expertise and is cheap to maintain, but it is a minor item that has not been observed for years and is easily replaced or removed.
Premium support extends the firm's core round-the-clock expert support, so it fits existing capabilities and the firm can read customer uptake well.

The data processing contract tool is distant from the hosting knowledge base, which limits the firm's ability to develop it, but GDPR compliance remains a real need for agency customers, so it stays for now at high risk of withdrawal.

Scalable agency hosting is the flagship that builds directly on the firm's owned data centers, in-house development and agency focus, giving it strong capacity to learn from results and improve the product.
